Dear Aiko,

Thank you for the second-round interview invitation. Regarding the proposed interview time on Wednesday, 12 November 2026, could you please clarify which day of the week you mean, as there is a mismatch with the calendar? I will submit the form accordingly.

The email says "Thursday, 13 November 2026, 17:00 JST", but 13 November 2026 is a Friday.
Could you please confirm which day you mean?

Best regards,
Tinish
